locations.name: Ranger Refuge
locations.description: Medical supplies and modest weapons. Central access, with several teams likely to rotate past.

locations.name: Sunwash Sands
locations.description: Long desert sightlines. Rooms hide ammunition and occasional rare rifles; an old buggy sits outside.

locations.name: Windpump Works
locations.description: Fuel, tools, and a service pickup. A useful departure point when the storm moves east.

locations.name: Frostwatch Flats

guns.name: Ridgeline

guns.name: Trail Scout

guns.name: Brushmaster
guns.description: Eight-pellet shotgun. Strong in close cover; limited reach.

guns.description: Compact, dependable pistol. A modest start that leaves more budget for spawn priority.
